# Corporate Terminals
Every work terminal pays into the corporate budget. Running the same job over and over pays less each time, so rotate between terminals.
## Records and Audit Compare ledger entries against the receipts and flag the ones that don't match. Pays up to $100, $250 or $400 depending on the batch.
## Logistics Load a shuttle for the best cargo value without going over any of its limits. An overloaded shuttle is refused. Pays up to $75, $125 or $200.
## Secure Transmissions Break an intercepted cipher key. After each guess the terminal tells you how many symbols are right and in place, and how many are right but in the wrong place. Fewer guesses pay more, up to $300, $450 or $600.
## Markets Trade commodity futures with the corporate budget. - Prices update every minute. - News reports come out before the move, so read the newswire before you trade. - Every trade costs a 3% fee, buying and selling, so trading at random loses money. - Holdings are capped at $5000. - Any position you're still holding when the shift ends is worth nothing.
## Research Research is still the corporation's main earner, and it only pays while the colony's research licence holds. See [textlink="Colony Relations" link="CMUCorporateHandbookRelations"/].
